title: The over-W transition as homology of a coefficient composite
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, W and S schemes, k:W→S, G a sheaf of Λ-modules on W_et, q an integer, and f:A→B in Over W. Put K_B=(B^*G)[0], K_A=(A^*G)[0], and K_M=(f^*B^*G)[0]. Let s:f^*K_B→K_M be the canonical single-complex comparison and c:K_M→K_A the single-functor image of the canonical coefficient identification f^*B^*G≅A^*G. Let l: R(B→S)_*K_B→R(A→S)_*(f^*K_B) be the fixed derived triangle transition. Then H^q(l ≫ R(A→S)_*(s ≫ c)) equals the fixed higherDirectImageOverMap from the higher image of B^*G to the higher image of A^*G. This is an equality of sheaf morphisms, without test objects, raw classes or evaluation maps.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 09Z1, canonical transition constructions; the functoriality identification in the proof of sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-comparison

proof.text: Apply higherDirectImageOverMap_coefficient_factorization to split the homology map of the composite. Apply higherDirectImageOverMap_coefficient_endpoint to identify the resulting factors with the canonical over-map.

mathlib_searches.query: Functor preserves composition and evaluation of a morphism of sheaves on a section commutes with composition
The degree zero single complex of a sheaf pulled back through composed scheme morphisms and the canonical coefficient identification
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits about Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp and structure-sheaf pullback coherence; none about this fixed small-etale module-sheaf construction.
DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor, singleFunctorιIso and singleFunctors. The construction uses singleFunctor directly.
singleFunctor is the existing Mathlib single complex; no raw-over helper is named there. The helper shares the existing construction and adds no notion.
Found CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Functor.Basic: F.map (f ≫ g) = F.map f ≫ F.map g. Constituent for the two functoriality steps, not the fixed higher-image identity.

mathlib_searches.query: Applying two functors to a composite morphism with a fixed prefix equals the composite of their mapped morphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits including CategoryTheory.FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply and CategoryTheory.Functorial.map_comp; none compares the concrete derived transition with higherDirectImageOverMap.

HigherDirectImageOverCoherence has identity and composition laws, HigherDirectImageTransitionIdentity uses the same functoriality rearrangement in an identity proof, and AbelianHigherDirectImageTransitionComp has private coefficient laws for abelian sheaves. No existing theorem states this fixed module-sheaf coefficient-composite identity.
mathlib_searches.verdict: no exact match; existing functoriality route confirmed

from.place: Identification of the mapped coefficient composite with the over-W transition

lean.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageOverMap_coefficient
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {A B : Over W} (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) q).map
      (lowerStarPlusTransition Λ f.left (B.hom ≫ k) (A.hom ≫ k)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, Over.w])
        (higherDirectImageRawOverComplex Λ G B) ≫
        R+((A.hom ≫ k)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).map
          (higherDirectImageRawOverCoefficient Λ G f)) =
      higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q f
